prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished editorial 3D raster background for the Program tab of BinaHub's program-recommendation landing; not a UI mockup.
Primary request: An elegant ascending fan of three broad translucent glass slabs, like sculptural layers choosing a clear path forward. Each layer offset gently upward and right, one navy optical-glass edge and warm champagne honey reflections. Refined product-design launch photography with real transmitted daylight, subtle caustics and soft contact shadows. Opaque ivory and pale champagne studio background, BinaHub navy #0B2C6B and gold #D9A441 used sparingly, mostly luminous clear warm glass. Landscape 3:2; sculpture on the right two-thirds/lower half, quiet nearly white warm upper-left negative space for a separate HTML heading. Distinct from a ribbon or lenses: broad layered planes, asymmetrical upward rhythm, not an icon, not steps/diagram, no UI cards. No words, text, typography, logos, people, watermarks, decorative stars, arrows, charts or controls. Keep edges defined; web page supplies its own frosted-glass overlay.
usage: Decorative editorial artwork for the matching manual tab; not a result or customer photograph.
